[MATH: T = (2+\pi) - \left(2-\pi\right) = 2\pi.]

[MATH: T = \dfrac{\pi}{B}.]

[MATH: 2\pi = \dfrac{\pi}{B} \quad\Longrightarrow\quad B = \dfrac{\pi}{2\pi} = \dfrac 1 2.]

Therefore, [MATH: B=\dfrac 1 2.]
